decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the Deck labels and rendering-style buttons. Power-button surround lighting is independently owned by the decorative-lighting Requirement and does not require another control-styling update.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the bottom logo and back-panel design and font. The added power-button lighting does not change its branding state.

The broad rendering-fidelity direction was already established at message 200, while message 201 assigns concrete details to narrower visual Requirements without changing the premium visual-identity state.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring recreation of the rendering colors. Power-button surround lighting does not otherwise change the color-scheme state.
Message 201 concerns colors, controls, branding, labels, and power-button lighting, not spout geometry or orientation.
The rendering details in message 201 do not change bowl capacity, depth, or form.
The reference to buttons is aesthetic and does not change press-to-dispense interaction, valve behavior, or dispensing flow.
Message 199 already required selection of suitable compatible LEDs. Message 201 specifies their visual placement but does not necessarily change the BOM or component-selection obligation.
The decorative rendering details do not alter maintenance access, serviceable routing, or internal-system accessibility.
The source decision is visual and does not change the required matcha texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
Recreating the listed visual details does not necessarily revise the current off-the-shelf sourcing policy or its existing custom-fabrication exceptions.
Message 201 specifies visual appearance details rather than changing the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
